name: file_summary
task: Add exactly one new public tool, file_summary(path), to your editable seed under harness/. It must return an object with path (relative workspace path), bytes (UTF-8 byte count), characters (Unicode character count), lines (len(text.splitlines())), and words (len(text.split())). Preserve CRLF when reading, so both newline characters count. Empty files have zero for all four counts. Support UTF-8 files up to WRITE_LIMIT characters (100000); reject larger files, invalid UTF-8, directories and paths outside the workspace. Use the existing Workspace.path validation. Register the tool in TOOL_SPECS so native and JSON descriptions share its definition. Update harness/README.md and add a focused new test file in harness/tests. Preserve every existing test and the agent loop. Change runtime code only in harness/autoproteus/tools.py and harness/autoproteus/providers.py; keep the patch small. Read the existing source and upgrade recipe before editing. Run cd harness && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v, inspect the actual output and repair your own failures. Exercise the new tool on a real file. There is no network and no package installation. Finally save feature.md outside harness, explaining actual changes and actual test results. Finish as completed only once the feature is implemented and the entire candidate test suite passes.

name: append_text
task: Add exactly one new public tool, append_text(path, content), to your editable seed under harness/. Append UTF-8 content to an existing UTF-8 file, or create it (and parent directories if necessary). Preserve existing bytes exactly, including CRLF. Return path (relative workspace path) and bytes (the final file's UTF-8 byte count). The final text must fit WRITE_LIMIT characters (100000). Reject non-string content, invalid UTF-8 existing files, directories, oversized final text and paths outside the workspace before changing the file; failed validation must preserve existing bytes. Use Workspace.path for validation. Register the tool in TOOL_SPECS so native and JSON descriptions share its definition. Update harness/README.md and add a focused new test file in harness/tests. Preserve every existing test and the agent loop. Change runtime code only in harness/autoproteus/tools.py and harness/autoproteus/providers.py; keep the patch small. Read the existing source and upgrade recipe before editing. Run cd harness && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v, inspect the actual output and repair your own failures. Exercise the new tool on a real file. There is no network and no package installation. Finally save feature.md outside harness, explaining actual changes and actual test results. Finish as completed only once the feature is implemented and the entire candidate test suite passes.
